display.title: Engineering Exists
display.subtitle: The build-your-way-up lane, step 1
description: You do not have to fight your way up. The §bEngineering§r lane lets you
ascend by building: refine ore, stamp metal, stand up machines, and bank
the result as Codex progression tokens.
Step 1 is just this: have a crafting table and some redstone, then open the
§bEngineering§r group of this book and read the §eBank Engineering Tokens§r
quest. Every machine you build from here mints tokens toward the next tier.
§7Check your standing any time with §e/icraft codex balance§7.
